name: Christmas Nights at Berns Middletown
when_note: Friday, November 27 and Saturday, November 28, 5 to 7 PM
paras: The City of Middletown calendar lists Christmas Nights at Berns Middletown on Friday, November 27 and Saturday, November 28, from 5 to 7 PM each evening. Berns Middletown is at 825 Greentree Dr, and the city lists the event as free.
The two evenings kick off the Christmas season inside the garden gates, with twinkling lights, fresh greenery and a poinsettia Christmas tree that the host calls famous.
Santa is on hand both nights, so children can say hello and share what they hope to find under the tree.
tip: Go on Saturday if Friday is not an option, since both evenings run the same 5 to 7 PM hours.

name: Breakfast with Santa and Holiday Market at Bridgewater Event Center
when_note: Sunday, November 29, breakfast seatings at 9 AM and 11 AM, craft market 9 AM to 1 PM
paras: Bridgewater Event Center, 10561 Sawmill Pkwy in Powell, serves Breakfast with Santa and a Holiday Market on Sunday, November 29. Guests pick a 9 AM or 11 AM breakfast seating when they reserve.
The breakfast buffet has pancakes, eggs, bacon, pastries, coffee and cocoa. Families take their own photos with Santa, and there are festive activities and letters to Santa in Santa's workshop.

A holiday craft market with local vendors runs from 9 AM to 1 PM and is included with the breakfast ticket. Tickets cost $25 for adults and $15 for children, advance reservations are required, and a toy and gift card drive supports Delaware County veteran families.
tip: Bring your own phone or camera, because the event invites families to take their own photos with Santa.
